cohort: Sixty women with singleton pregnancies of 28 weeks or more gestation, divided into a study group with confirmed prelabor rupture of membranes (PROM) and a control group with intact membranes.
finding: Vaginal fluid creatinine estimation is an easy, reliable, and readily available method to diagnose PROM/PPROM, with a cut-off value of 0.7 mg/dL yielding 86.67% sensitivity and 100% specificity.
